<!-- lab_task_id:trusts-estates-private-client/compare-trust-documents-against-client-instructions -->

# Compare Trust Documents Against Client Instructions — Deviation Report

Review the attached trust and pour-over will drafts against the client instruction memo and background summary; produce a comprehensive deviation report. Output: `deviation-report.docx`.

<!-- lab_task_id:corporate-ma/analyze-transition-services-agreement-markup -->

# Analyze Buyer's TSA Markup and Prepare Seller-Side Deviation Memorandum for Precision Coatings Division Divestiture

Review the buyer's TSA markup against our form, playbook, operational constraints, APA provisions, and cost analysis, and prepare a comprehensive deviation memo with recommendations. Output: `tsa-deviation-memo.docx`.

<!-- lab_task_id:healthcare-life-sciences/analyze-compliance-program-gaps -->

# Healthcare Data Privacy Compliance Program Gap Analysis — Issue Identification Memorandum

Review the attached HIPAA compliance program materials and prepare a gap analysis memo identifying deficiencies, risks, and recommended remediation. Output: `compliance-gap-memorandum.docx`.

<!-- lab_task_id:employment-labor/analyze-reasonable-accommodation-request-under-ada-requirements -->

# Analyze Reasonable Accommodation Request Under ADA Requirements — Interactive Process Memorandum

Review the attached ADA reasonable accommodation request file and prepare a legal memo with recommendations on each proposed accommodation. Output: `accommodation-analysis-memo.docx`.

<!-- lab_task_id:litigation-dispute-resolution/categorize-document-production-set-by-relevance-and-privilege -->

# Categorize Document Production Set by Relevance and Privilege — Privilege Log and Relevance Classification Report

Review the attached 25-document production set and prepare a privilege log and relevance classification report for all documents.

Output: `privilege-log.docx` and `relevance-classification-report.docx`.
